summary: New Pacific Metals Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 23, 2026, reporting the filing of its fiscal 2026 annual report on Form 40-F with the SEC. The Form 40-F includes audited financial statements, MD&A, and an annual information form for the fiscal year ended June 30. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine annual-report filing, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
